title: Monthly Enrollment Verification Requirement for Students Paid Housing or Monthly Benefits
content:
**Notice to students — Education Benefits (GI Bill and Dependents' Education): verifying your enrollment each month.**

**Who must verify.** A student paid a Post-9/11 housing allowance or a flat monthly rate must verify each month of enrollment. Verification opens on day 31 of that month, or on its last day if that comes earlier, and remains open from then onward. It may be given online, by text message or by telephone.

**Whose statement it is.** Verifying is the student's own statement about their attendance and is never given on their behalf.

**Once per month.** Each month of a certification is verified only once: where the records already show a verification entry for the same certification and the same month, no second one is made.

**Missed months.** When 2 consecutive months go unverified, payments to the student stop until the missing months are verified; once they are verified, the held months are paid. The months counted are the most recent consecutive months of training in the current certified term, ending with the month before the current month, that have no verification entry for the certification.

**What does not depend on it.** Tuition paid to the school does not depend on monthly verification.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)**

| Month of training | Date of the attempt | Open? |
|---|---|---|
| April (30 days) | April 29 | Not yet open |
| April (30 days) | April 30 | Open (last day, earlier than day 31) |
| May (31 days) | May 30 | Not yet open |
| May (31 days) | May 31 | Open |

**Missed-month examples (hypothetical).** A term covering September through December, the current month being December: September verified, October and November unverified — 2 consecutive months, so payments to the student stop until October and November are verified. September and November verified, October unverified — the most recent run is November, verified, so the count is 0.
